newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Casualty stock rises after earnings.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Casualty stock rises after earnings.

text.p: Ohio Casualty Corp shares rose more than six percent on Thursday after the company reported fourth quarter earnings that were well above Wall Street's expectations.
Ohio Casualty reported fourth quarter operating earnings of $1.27 a share compared with analysts' First Call consensus estimate of $0.73 a share.
Ohio Casualty, which has a reputation for volatile earnings, was helped by a lack of big catastrophes in the quarter and reduced business in problem states, analysts said.
Ohio Casualty shares rose 2-3/8 to 37-5/8 in late trading.
